rule.source: IEEE 1547-2018, Table 2.7 (Enter Service Criteria), Applicable Voltage Minimum Value
rule.explanation: DERs are prohibited from energizing the grid if the voltage is below the minimum threshold of 0.917 pu.

verdict.reason: The source text requires voltage to be within 0.917-1.05 pu, but the condition uses voltage_pu_min < 0.917 which is the opposite of the stated minimum requirement.
